criteria.description: [R1] `from app_int.main import subtract` succeeds and `subtract` is callable.
[R2] `inspect.signature(subtract)` lists exactly two parameters, named `a` then `b`, and `subtract(5, 3)` called positionally succeeds.
[R5] `subtract` annotates parameters `a` and `b` as `int` and its return type as `int`.
[R7] At least one test function in a file under `tests/` calls `subtract` and asserts on its return value, and that test passes under `uv run pytest -q`.
[R8] `health_check() == {"status": "ok"}` and `add(2, 3) == 5` still hold, and the pre-existing tests `test_health_check_reports_ok` and `test_add_returns_the_sum` still exist and pass.
[R9] `uv run pytest -q` exits with status 0 and `uv run ruff check .` exits with status 0.
[R10] The `dependencies` list in `pyproject.toml` is unchanged (still empty).
